integrity: Analytic proofs supply the universal conclusions; computational comparisons are corroborative and finite. Historical priority has residual uncertainty; no external independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Finite fixed alphabet of at least two categories; positive Dirichlet shape coordinates; the shape-balancing theorem is only local at fixed total concentration. No higher-order classification at the critical curvature and no global extremum are claimed. The standard Dirichlet moment identity is not presented as novel.
title: Entropy–collision anticorrelation and a Dirichlet symmetry-breaking threshold
